events.place: Gnidow, Dubensky Uyezd, Volhynian Governorate, Russian Empire

notes: Adolph and his wife Sophie and their family lived on Tweed Ave. See photo in Fingler book. Viola Metz, in her letter dated 5/14/97 makes reference to "my Dad's uncle Adolph".  According to Viola, his uncle was deaf and her father, Phillip Fingler used to give him odd jobs because he had little income.
